absent: Numeric ABI values and bit layouts for advice, VMA flag, page-walk, swap-entry and userfaultfd constants.
Merge state machine transitions after the initial phase and the modify routine success and failure contract.
Internals of page walking, TLB gathering, folio splitting and isolation, reclaim, swap I/O and notifier delivery.
Lock ordering among address-space, VMA, page-table, RCU and userfaultfd locks beyond the drops shown.
Huge-TLB and transparent huge-page helper preconditions, alignment rules beyond the shown checks, and error cases.

findings.text: A merge descriptor can be built from an existing area plus traversal context, predecessor and interval. It records owning address space, neighbours, bounds, inherited protections, file and anonymous offsets, backing store linkage, anonymous ownership and naming, placement policy, userfaultfd linkage, and an initial phase marker.

A rename helper creates that descriptor for a subrange of a supplied area, substitutes a caller supplied anonymous name, then delegates to the common modify and merge routine and returns its resulting area.

Willneed advice branches on backing type. Anonymous ranges use a page-table walk that prefetches swapped pages then drains local caches. Shared-memory ranges scan the page cache for swapped entries and prefetch them then drain. Direct-access file ranges ignore the hint successfully. Other file ranges retain a file reference, record that the address-space lock was dropped, release it around a filesystem willneed hint for the corresponding file offset and length, then reacquire it.

The anonymous prefetch walk iterates page by page within each middle-level entry, mapping the leaf table once per span. Entries that are not swapped are skipped while holding the leaf lock. Swapped entries are fetched asynchronously with the lock released and the temporary reference dropped, and after the span all queued reads are submitted followed by a scheduling opportunity.

The shared-memory prefetch scans cache indices for the interval under read-side protection, ignoring present pages and non-swap markers including error markers. Each swapped index is converted to the matching virtual address, the scan is paused and protection released around an asynchronous fetch with the temporary reference dropped, then protection is reacquired; queued reads are submitted at the end.

Two paths may drop the address-space read lock: file willneed around filesystem advice and removal notification around userfaultfd event delivery. Both record the drop where applicable, hold a stable reference across the drop, and reacquire before continuing; the discard path revalidates the area and clamps the end after reacquiring.

Cold and pageout share one leaf scanner with a mode flag. Locked, special-mapped or huge-TLB areas are rejected. Shared file areas without owner or write access skip file pages, and some shared writable file areas return early without work. Shared or non-reclaimable folios are left alone. Large folios fully covered are handled whole; partially covered ones are split when exclusive and lockable, otherwise skipped. Both modes clear referenced and young history and mark active folios as working set; cold then deactivates while pageout isolates and reclaims, skipping unevictable folios. Transparent huge entries have an analogous whole-entry path with zero, non-present and partial-coverage handling.

Free advice applies only to anonymous areas and walks with a notifier range and TLB session. Huge middle entries try a dedicated huge handler first. For leaves, swapped runs release swap references, adjust the swap-entry counter and clear the tables; poison markers are cleared. Large folios use batched contiguity detection and split only when partially covered, exclusive and lockable. Swap-cached or dirty folios are cleaned only when fully and exclusively mapped and swap can be freed. Young or dirty mappings are cleared with TLB invalidation, then the folio is marked lazily free.

Discard validation forbids special-mapped areas and, except for a locked-tolerant variant, locked areas; huge-TLB areas accept only discard variants, require aligned start and round the end down to huge granularity, possibly emptying the range. The orchestrator validates, handles empty ranges, invokes removal notification and, if the lock was dropped, relocks, relooks up the area, revalidates and clamps the end before dispatching to discard or free handlers.

Removal notification is skipped when no context exists or the recipient did not request remove events. Otherwise the context is referenced, the changing count incremented under the map-changing lock, the address-space lock released, a remove event published for the interval, and completion awaited. The waiter enqueues visibly for poll and read, sleeps in killable state with periodic wakeups until acknowledged, released or signalled, handles a fork payload release, then decrements the count and drops references.

The scanners yield the processor after spans and after reclaim work, reestablish mappings after yielding, bound batches before checking for pending rescheduling with unlock and relock, and abort promptly when a fatal signal is pending or the waiter is exiting.

Page-table scanners run under a read walk lock, with free selecting a verifying VMA-read variant when operating under VMA locking. Each span sets the expected page size, takes the appropriate middle or leaf lock, flushes pending invalidations, brackets updates with a lazy update window, and pairs TLB session start and end around each area walk.
